prompt: IMPORTANT: plain live television look. No sparks, no fire, no glowing effects, no cartoon effects. Nobody wears boxing gloves or MMA gloves - bare knuckles with thin red hand wraps only, the cat's paws are bare fur. Continuous single shot, no cuts, camera completely LOCKED on a tripod with only a tiny tremble; it does NOT zoom, push in, orbit or travel. Bare-knuckle boxing ring. Timing of the shot, follow it exactly: SECONDS 0-1: the giant white cat and the female fighter stand apart at clean punching range, both visible full body, the cat throws one testing paw jab. SECONDS 1-4: the cat throws a fast combination of four separate open-paw strikes, one clearly after another. She retreats in a straight line, ducking and covering behind her forearms. They NEVER clinch, never grab, never collapse into each other - a clear gap stays between their bodies the whole time and both stay fully visible in frame. She NEVER throws a punch and never touches the cat. SECONDS 4-5: the cat lands one huge overhand paw, she is lifted off her feet and falls backwards onto the canvas. SECONDS 5-8: she lies completely still exactly where she fell, on her back, and she does NOT move, does not roll over, does not get up and does not change position or place. The cat stands beside her, calmly lowers its paw and licks it. Shot on a long telephoto lens with shallow depth of field: the fighters and the ropes are sharp, the crowd and the banners behind the ring stay out of focus, no letters or logos legible behind the ring. The ring stays exactly as in the first frame: same corner pads, ropes, canvas and on-screen graphics bar. Do not invent or re-spell any text, no gibberish, no logos of any other fight promotion. Real fight speed, natural motion blur, correct anatomy, no extra limbs, no morphing paws, no bodies jumping to a different place. Photorealistic. No blood, no injury, comedic tone. Audio: arena crowd, four separate slaps as the paws land, one heavy impact as she hits the canvas, then the crowd explodes. No music, no commentary, no speech.
